title: 第005章：突破
lines: 可他偏偏没有这么做，这些年反而多了个‘人鱼王因王后离世，所以性情大变’的流言。
学成后，所有人如火如荼的投身到了建设国家中，并在有余力的条件下，发展了自己的学生。
在修炼体系天长日久的发展之中，形成了一套完整的鉴定灵脉、辨识根骨的办法。收录弟子是道法传承一等一的大事，因此鉴辨高阶修炼体质的法门，一向为各家各派不传之秘。
其次是因为所有人都被梁宇凡的气势压了下去，全都一脸呆板地看着梁宇凡。
半柱香后，刘翠花到了顾鸣朝家里的门口，在刘翠花的前脚，顾桑玦刚回来，正要高兴拿下了镇上的宅子，刚拴好门要转身进屋，就听到门外哐哐哐的十分沉重的砸门声。
“找到了这个！”她将方才掐下来还没来得及种上的花枝，从袖子里拿出来插在哲赫头上，她瞧着堂堂西戎王头上别着个她采下来的花枝忍不住笑了，阳光恰好印在她的天上，那一刻她笑的格外灿烂，像极了朵张扬的芍药。
说着，大史的右臂处，缓缓的变形出来了一把狙击枪，枪口直接瞄准了两人。
华夏族？饶是花婆婆见多识广也从来没有听说过兽神大陆有这样一个部落。
在某处古老遗迹中，那里有着一颗龙蛋，龙蛋被放置在遗迹中不知多少的岁月。
“如果狮族派出大批军队的话，按照他们的速度，最多三个月就可以来到中央森林。”狼煜的语气中有着前所未有的沉重，就连寒季来临的时候狼煜都没有如此严肃过。
第二，就是因为傅野欠曹以沫的，她想如果傅野清醒的时候听到曹以沫的哀求，一定会毫不犹豫的答应的。她现在答应了，就当是帮傅野还一个大大的人情。
傅野心软了几分，弯腰抱起她。还是跟前几天她膝盖受伤时的一样的那个公主抱。
“那么，可以接受这个吗？”常青青突然间转身，然后将自己的后背露了出来。我看到她的后背延着脊椎骨的地方布着一道鳞片，十分细而软的那种，白色的，在阳光下甚至反射着淡淡的光芒。
当然，徐子枫他们本来就很无辜，好好的坐在那认真的打比赛，突然被人用饮料瓶打脸，难道不无辜么？难道不是受害者么？
她没有等到他亲口对她说爱，却在临死的那一瞬间，明白了他的心意。
薛华心里存着疑惑，顾仁峰已答应让他回来接管顾家，怎会允许进入顾家核心管理层，难道是想两人相互制肘？应该不可能，顾仁峰是个骨灰级的人精，清楚他对楚韵的感情，若是她想要的，他绝对不会与之争夺。
这些公子绝对是人中龙杰，经常不知从哪里抱回来一些稀奇的宝贝放到自己的院子，没过多久这些宝贝就不见了，公子们就找狩琪诉苦，狩琪好言安抚，他们竟不在追究。
几人听完姜俪的解释之后，脸上均露出惊讶之色，不得不说，香儿网咖总店无论是硬件设施还是软件设施，都是最顶尖的，这在网咖这个行业里面，算得上顶尖豪华了。
这么说的话，他究竟是一直在暗中观察他和寒朔，还是只是单纯的在观察凌络琦？
虽然这个时候给他们打电话，今天晚上他们势必会睡不着觉，可他真的等不到明天了，而他想，他们也是期待这个电话的。
一晚上未归，又换过衣裳，太会引人往别处想，人多眼杂，有心之人看到传出去坏事。
有的时候，击垮一个超级巨星非常简单，一句谣言，一个花边新闻，就会彻底改变粉丝们心中的想法。
“哈哈，我想师兄误会了，台下学子众多，你猜谁能取得这次的榜首呢？”院长放声大笑，似乎已经习惯了自己师兄对自己的态度，继续问道。
邹子琛把酒杯放到一旁，侧身捧起我的脸，双眸亮闪闪的望着我，随之印上我的唇，一点点的进入，细细的品味着，温柔而缠|绵，他唇间满是红酒的香气，他这一吻似乎也把我给灌醉了。
“好厉害！崔大哥，你的元素力量掌控得这么好。”林渊惊呼一声，实在难以相信。
景秀只是想着自己的绣屏要赶紧绣完，不然今晚又得熬夜来这里绣，连续熬了几晚上，身子有些吃不消。
景秀失笑，大抵是住过金碧辉煌的大明宫，于她而言，这简陋的青石堆砌平头房确实破破烂烂。
在他的认知中，除了颜雪晴，还从未听说过谁掌握了生命规则之力，两年多了，这两年多的时间里，他对颜雪晴的思念，从未断过。
今日就算赢了，也会有人说是人家故意让的，这要是说出去，不是一个笑话？
“呵呵，我这就让玉瑶过来，舒兄咱俩到后院区采一些需要的灵药吧。”秦炜君说。
叶锦棠再度惊讶，要知道，她之前最大的单子也才一百万，秦白暮居然给她一千五百万？
十分钟一场的幽灵场，刷出来的高票房，都不被爆出来才有鬼呢。

As soon as he locked the door and turned around to enter the house, he heard a very heavy banging on the door.
"Found this!" She pinched off the flower branch that she had not yet planted, took it out of her sleeve and inserted it on Zhehe's head. She couldn't help but smile when she saw the flower branch she picked on the head of the majestic King of Xirong. The sun happened to be printed on her sky. At that moment, her smile was particularly bright, like a flamboyant peony.
As he spoke, a sniper rifle slowly transformed from Da Shi's right arm, and the muzzle of the gun was directly aimed at the two of them.
Chinese people? Although Granny Hua is well-informed, she has never heard of such a tribe in the Beast God Continent.

"So, can you accept this?" Chang Qingqing suddenly turned around and exposed her back. I saw a line of scales on her back extending from her spine. They were very thin and soft, white, and even reflected a faint light in the sun.
Of course, Xu Zifeng and the others were very innocent to begin with. They were sitting there and playing the game seriously, but suddenly they were slapped in the face with a drink bottle. Aren't they innocent? Aren't they victims?
She didn't wait for him to express his love to her in person, but at the moment of her death, she understood what he meant.
Xue Hua had doubts in his heart. Gu Renfeng had promised to let him come back to take over the Gu family. How could he be allowed to enter the core management of the Gu family? Is it because they wanted to restrain each other? It shouldn't be possible. Gu Renfeng is a hard-core human being and knows his feelings for Chu Yun. If she wants it, he will never fight for it.
These young men are definitely outstanding among people. They often bring back some rare treasures from nowhere and put them in their own yards. After a while, these treasures disappear. The young men come to complain to Shou Qi, but Shou Qi comforts them so much that they don't pursue the matter.
After listening to Jiang Li's explanation, several people had expressions of surprise on their faces. It has to be said that Xiang'er Internet Cafe Main Store is top-notch in terms of both hardware and software facilities. This is considered top-notch luxury in the Internet cafe industry.
If you put it this way, has he been secretly observing him and Han Shuo, or is he simply observing Ling Luoqi?
Although if he called them at this time, they would definitely not be able to sleep tonight, but he really couldn't wait until tomorrow, and he thought they were also looking forward to this call.
Not returning home all night and changing clothes again will lead people to think elsewhere. There are many people with mixed eyes, and those who are interested may see bad things spread.
Sometimes, it is very simple to defeat a superstar. A rumor or tidbit can completely change the minds of fans.
"Haha, I think senior brother has misunderstood. There are many students in the audience, who do you think will get the top spot this time?" The dean laughed loudly, seeming to be used to his senior brother's attitude towards him, and continued to ask.
Zou Zichen put the wine glass aside, held my face sideways, looked at me with shining eyes, then pressed his lips to mine, entering little by little, savoring it carefully, tender and lingering, his lips were full of the aroma of red wine, and his kiss seemed to make me drunk.
"It's amazing! Brother Cui, you control the elemental power so well." Lin Yuan exclaimed, it was really hard to believe.
Jingxiu just thought that she had to finish her embroidery screen quickly, otherwise she would have to stay up late to embroider here again tonight. After staying up for several nights in a row, her body was a little overwhelmed.
Jingxiu laughed because she had probably lived in the magnificent Daming Palace. To her, this simple bluestone flat-top house was indeed in tatters.
In his knowledge, apart from Yan Xueqing, he has never heard of anyone who has mastered the power of the rules of life. It has been more than two years. In these two years, his thoughts about Yan Xueqing have never stopped.
Even if we win today, some people will say that they conceded on purpose. If this were told, wouldn’t it be a joke?
"Haha, I'll ask Yuyao to come over now. Brother Shu, let's go to the backyard area to collect some needed elixirs." Qin Weijun said.
Ye Jintang was surprised again. You know, her previous largest order was only one million, but Qin Baimu actually gave her fifteen million?

content_zh:
《盘龙桩》属于中乘功法，也是雕龙功的根基所在。

    入门、小成、大成、圆满四个阶段，前二对应搬血，后二对应煅骨。

    特点是打熬体魄，根基稳固。

    像陈孤舟曾修行过的搬血劲，则是一门烂大街的下乘功法。

    特点是通俗易懂，大家都能学。

    至于缺点。

    等他后来修行同样烂大街的‘磨盘功’，便体现了出来。

    二者完全不是一个路子，所炼气血如脱缰野马。导致他准备煅骨时，难度提高了十倍不止。

    最重要的是。

    《盘龙桩》《戏珠手》二者合一，是上乘功法，有望突破通脉境。

    戏珠手是一门技法，一共十八式。

    修行之初需以开水烧烫铁珠，双手分而‘戏’之，直至运指如飞，不觉烫手。然后二珠、三珠、四珠……

    其间需辅以功法中附带的药方，使药力渗透皮肉，在铁珠的刺激下增进双手韧性、灵活。

    从九珠开始。

    以滚油烧烫铁珠，直至双手同飞十八枚铁珠，方可功法圆满。

    “这是奠基功法？难度有点变态了。”

    稍作尝试之后。

    陈孤舟有了一个清晰认知。

    如果没有巧手词条，这门功法的难度，他一定是练不成的。

    “不过——”陈孤舟手指一顿，“雕龙刀的兵法，在哪呢？”

    想了一瞬。

    他便会过意来。

    自己如今不过一个‘小学生’，老师又怎么会把‘大学课程’摆到面前。

    想学核心功法，最低要求也得通脉。

    估计还要经过雕龙一脉的掌舵人周雕龙考验。

    一个月后。

    果然如赵志才所言，陈孤舟的巧手词条再显潜力，戏珠手顺利踏入‘七珠’。七枚烧开的铁珠在十指翻飞，缕缕白烟升起，丝毫不觉滚烫。

    赵志才赞不绝口，陈孤舟也觉十分满意。

    当练习到九珠时。

    在功法锻炼与药膏双重刺激下，巧手词条潜力突破极限——按赵志才的说法，便是觉醒了武道根骨。

    陈孤舟清晰感觉到，双掌血肉筋膜逐渐滋生一缕薄薄的气血。

    灵动自如，控制随心。

    搬血！

    他终于重新踏入修行门槛。

    这一缕气血，虽不如肌魁词条带来的浑厚，甚至相差千里，但胜在控制自如。

    而这。

    正代表了突破煅骨的潜力！

    随后，陈孤舟开始正式修行盘龙桩。

    盘龙桩同样有十八式，练的是整体肌肉、筋骨。

    结合戏珠手对身体的细微控制，不断打熬全身每一丝肌肉，辅助一副三两银子的药膳‘龟蛇茯草汤’。

    每日食补滋养肉身，再运功转化。

    如此孜孜不倦，陈孤舟的气血提升很快。
